overview_description.description: Lifemost is a corporate well-being platform for physical and mental health, providing tech solutions for enterprises. Lifemost combines hybrid well-being benefits, including offline and online activities for fitness, mindfulness, and active recovery, as well as live sessions with psychologists and health coaches. The core Lifemost innovation is an anAI-powered assistant that is designed to deliver data-driven well-being programs throughout organizations by reducing barriers in personalization and engagement
